messages:
emma: quick sync 1 benchmark narrative for launch 1 need: 1 hero visual, short hero copy that avoids raw prices, and inbound CTA routing.

liam: paste mock numbers and i'll index (Redwood=1.0) + add p95 inset. recommend % deltas not raw $s.

emma: mock data for comps:
```
model,median_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k,tokens_per_$
Redwood-Core,100,220,0.11,9090
OpenEdge,240,820,0.04,25000
QuantSmall,160,300,0.07,14285
```

zoe: two visual options: A) horizontal bars tokens-per-$ with tiny p95 sparkline; B) scatter (latency vs $) with quadrants. prefer A for landing.

ravi: agree on A for hero. include a tiny tooltip: "Indexed vs Redwood (1.0). p95 inset shows tail risk."

mike: CTA routing: devs -> "Try in 5 mins" (self-serve); infra -> "Request architecture review" (form + AE). webinar CTA separate: "See methodology".

liam: methodology blurb: "Synthetic service workload; batching and KV cache enabled; results indexed for comparability." i'll produce CSV + PNG for download.

emma: hero copy options: "Predictable token economics at production scale" vs "Lower $/token, tighter tail latency". which lands?

zoe: first for landing (signals control), second for webinar (punchy).

ravi: action items: liam -> indexed chart + p95 inset (Thu EOD); zoe -> hero + deep-dive mockups (Fri AM); mike -> CTA copy + routing (Fri); emma -> draft footnote/method. reconvene Mon to pick hero.

bot: Shortcut created: https://app.shortcut.com/redwood-inference/story/bench-3421001234 (assignees: liam, zoe, mike, emma)
